description: transferDomain: Stage transfer of a domain from another registrar to OSIR. Deducts from account balance. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

authCode.description: EPP authorization code obtained from the current registrar.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to transfer, like "example.com", without scheme.

registrantInfo.description: ICANN registrant contact of the domain owner: firstName, lastName, email, phone (+CC.number), and address (street, city, postalCode, country as 2-letter ISO code).

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: transferDomain
